title: Skill/Pluginは製品固有形式ではなくAgent Skills spec（SKILL.md）とAgent Plugins spec 1.0.0に準拠したportable folderを正本にし、製品別pathはsymlink/thin adapterにする。Sessionは製品固有のためGit成果物（commit・progress file・PR）を正本にする。

problem_titles.K08: ProviderやAgent製品ごとにSession・Skill形式が分断される

why_not_autonomous: R3 operation or structural decision: source-of-truth / structural choice requires a human decision
existing_capabilities: Agent Skills specification (SKILL.md frontmatter, scripts/references/assets, `skills-ref validate`) — agentskills.io
Agent Plugins spec 1.0.0 (plugin.json, skills/ MUST conform; hooks/agents/commands non-portable in v1)
shared-agent-plugins already keeps portable plugin folders with .claude-plugin/.codex-plugin adapters and per-product symlinks in consumers
options: A: declare the portable folder (Agent Skills + Agent Plugins 1.0.0) the source of truth for every shared Skill/Plugin; product paths (.claude/skills, .agents/skills, .codex) are symlinks/thin adapters only; add `skills-ref validate` (or equivalent) to the shared repository check and to consumer skills:audit; sessions are never a source of truth — Git artifacts (commits, progress files, PRs) are
B: keep product-native layouts and copy between products — rejected: drift already observed
C: portable folders without validation tooling — cheaper, but spec drift goes unnoticed
proposed_action: A. Structural because it fixes the source-of-truth for assets across products and organisations; the shared repository owner decides, then the controller can add the validator as an R1/R2 change to the shared repository check.
implementation_target: shared-agent-plugins repository conventions (docs + check script) and each consumer link layout; no autonomous change until decided
evaluation_plan: spec validator passes for 100% of shared Skills; product-adapter line count stays flat when a product is added; a consumer adds a new product path with a symlink only (no copied Skill body); Git artifacts (not sessions) suffice to resume a paused task in a smoke test

evidence.summary: 採用client一覧にClaude Code、ChatGPT & Codex、GitHub Copilot、VS Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、OpenHands、Goose、Kiro等。'Cross-product reuse: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent'。
Agent Plugins 1.0.0: plugin.json（$schema,name必須）、skills/はAgent Skills specに'MUST conform'、mcp.json（stdio/streamable-http/sse）。hooks/agents/commandsはv1では非portable（client拡張）。
Claude Code sessionはlocal JSONL・内部形式で製品間互換なし（形式は版で変わる）。
